## The cause, and the correction to this bead

This bead's title says the zeros appear "for factions whose turn is not being processed". That is
the OPPOSITE of the truth and it would have led to a fix that could not work.

`mod_production_phase(faction_id)` zeroes energy_surplus_total, facility_maint_total and
turn_commerce_income at its start (game.cpp), `labs_total` accumulates per base
(base.cpp:2768), and all of them are re-summed one base at a time. **mod_base_build fires inside
that window.** So the affected faction is the one being processed right now, caught partway
through its own accounting — not a bystander.

two greps away. A plausible story fitted the data and I did not check it before filing.

_setback's own doctrine about denominators, and the case is stronger here than where it was
written: na-s4e made "net income is negative, this never recovers" REPRESENTABLE, so 0 is a value
the vocabulary now genuinely admits. A zero is therefore indistinguishable from a real
measurement; an absent field is not. A directive against a missing metric reads UNMEASURABLE,
which is the true state and which the orchestrator already handles.
